title: Interview or survey synthesis
description: Codes feedback, validates themes, prioritizes recommendations, and preserves source traceability.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: interview-survey-synthesis
  title: Interview or survey synthesis
  description: Codes feedback, validates themes, prioritizes recommendations, and preserves source traceability.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Turn qualitative and quantitative feedback into actionable, representative insights.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - research-lead
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Interviews or survey responses
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - responses
          - objectives
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: code-a
      kind: agent
      name: Independent thematic coding A
      role: Qualitative researcher
      prompt: Code responses into themes, sentiment, frequency, and illustrative quotes. Preserve minority views.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - research
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: code-b
      kind: agent
      name: Independent thematic coding B
      role: Qualitative researcher
      prompt: Independently code responses and identify themes, exceptions, and ambiguity.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - research
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: reconcile
      name: Reconcile theme taxonomy
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Qualitative reconciliation analyst
      prompt: Reconcile both independent codebooks into a traceable theme taxonomy. Preserve material disagreement and map
        every theme to source responses.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - research
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: prioritize
      kind: agent
      name: Prioritize recommendations
      role: Research strategist
      prompt: Prioritize recommendations by prevalence, impact, feasibility, confidence, and alignment to objectives.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: research-lead
      kind: approval
      name: Research lead approves synthesis
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Theme report and prioritized recommendations
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: code-a
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: code-b
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: code-a
      to: reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: code-b
      to: reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: reconcile
      to: prioritize
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: prioritize
      to: research-lead
      kind: dependency
    - id: e7
      from: research-lead
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
